title: Pixlaria — Free Browser MMORPG with Crafting & Housing
author: mektigh
selftext:
Hello!  
  
A good friend of mine has started building an indie game called Pixlaria (you can check it out here: [https://pixlaria.com](https://pixlaria.com/)). It's still in a pretty early stage of development, so its really **being built together with the community right now.**

Since the game is at the beginning of its journey, I thought it would be fun to share it to get more players and feedback for him. If you like being able to shape where a game goes, or if you just want to help out an indie developer and help mold your dream game along the way, ***it’s a great time to jump on board***.

You can leave feedback directly in the game or hop into the Discord server. It's a growing community with really dedicated and friendly players, so the vibe is super welcoming if you want to drop by and share your thoughts.

Let me know if you give it a try and I'll pass the feedback along to the developer and the other way around for questions about the game.

**Note from dev:** This is ***not a single one-line-prompt*** you can just pop to you'r AI and get in a heartbeat, this game is indeed developed with heavy usage of AI, primarely Claude Opus 5.5 but with elements built with both Fable and Codex.  
There are hundreds of hours put into the game with a carefully crafted workflow and the core structure is the eye for detail in every step of the development.

Click [**here**](https://pixlaria.com/play) to [**Play now!**](https://pixlaria.com/play)  
  
Thanks!
